title: P0 mandatory recovery (IAP + Frenemies + For You/Home)
objective: On branch feat/full-tip-package-20260809 from clean base 723c27d8 (+ live-service compile commit), implement ONLY mandatory P0 recovery: (1) IAP Play title = app label = grant for 100/500/1000/2500/5000 with no oversell; (2) Frenemies Auto OFF anytime, host-tap default, settings work, queue drop/fill, first-hit protection, just-dropped cooldown, comment join wired, INVITED slot expiry; (3) For You/Home lag: max ~1 playing + limited warm (not 5 continuous decoders), bidirectional warm, Home scroll pauses rail decode. Do not survey product history. Do not tip-bake or Play-upload. Do not deploy from builders.
acceptanceCriteria: App coin pack labels and server iapCatalog grants are exactly 100/500/1000/2500/5000; playTitle matches grant; no UI/path credits legacy oversell totals (550/1150/3000/6500).
Frenemies: autoContinue defaults OFF; host can set Auto OFF (and ON) in any phase via autoContinue-only settings patch without SETTINGS_LOCKED; other settings remain fairness-locked mid-round.
Frenemies queue: drop/fill FIFO, first-hit protection, just-dropped cooldown, comment-source join path exists, INVITED seats expire and free the slot (decline/expiry re-queues when game active).
For You feed: at most 1 playing decoder plus at most 1 muted warm neighbor (WARM_RADIUS<=1); bidirectional; Home For You rail unloads warm neighbors while hub scrolls.
Deterministic live-service unit tests and focused mobile/type checks listed in verification pass on the frozen candidate.
No tip bake, Play upload, merge, or production deploy performed by agents.

args: const fs=require('fs');const cat=fs.readFileSync('backend/blyp-live-service/src/economy/iapCatalog.ts','utf8');const svc=fs.readFileSync('src/services/BlypCoinService.js','utf8');const need=[100,500,1000,2500,5000];for(const n of need){if(!cat.includes('coinsGranted: '+n)||!cat.includes("playTitle: '"+n+" coins'")) {console.error('catalog missing',n);process.exit(1);} if(!svc.includes('coins: '+n+',')){console.error('client missing',n);process.exit(1);}} if(/coinsGranted:\s*(550|1150|3000|6500)/.test(cat)) {console.error('oversell grant');process.exit(1);} console.log('iap-ok');

const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('src/screens/HomeScreen.js','utf8');if(!/WARM_RADIUS\s*=\s*1/.test(h)){console.error('WARM_RADIUS must be 1');process.exit(1);} if(/WARM_RADIUS\s*=\s*2/.test(h)){console.error('WARM_RADIUS=2 still present');process.exit(1);} console.log('decode-ok');
